purpose: Teach: プライス/デイリー/タイムリー/コントラスト/不合格/日本経済新聞/レジスト/博覧

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プライスタグの貼り直しを進めましょう
lines.en: Let's get those price tags replaced.
lines.style: Businesslike opening. Alert, forward momentum. Practical instruction delivered with quiet confidence. No pause between thought and speech.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。デイリーレポートを毎朝確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll check the daily report first thing every morning.
lines.style: Immediate, attentive response. Small nod in the voice. Warm agreement — showing he's listening and taking it seriously. Slight formality of deference without servility.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: タイムリーな広告で売上を伸ばしましょう
lines.en: Let's boost sales through timely advertising.
lines.style: Clear strategic instruction. Slight lift on "timely" — this matters. Measured pace. Authority that invites collaboration, not compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。写真のコントラストを調整します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adjust the photo contrast.
lines.style: Swift confirmation. Professional tone. No embellishment — just direct acknowledgment and execution. Kenji tracking with her momentum.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 品質テスト不合格の原因を分析しましょう
lines.en: Let's analyze what's causing these quality test failures.
lines.style: Slight concern beneath the instruction. Thoughtful pace — this is worth getting right. Not panic, but deliberate. Weight on "analyze."

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日本経済新聞の連載を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request that series from the Nikkei.
lines.style: Quick confirmation. Businesslike. He's keeping up, showing competence. Slight formality — acknowledging the scope of the task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: レジスト塗布工程を見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the resist coating process.
lines.style: Measured instruction. Careful attention — this is technical ground. No rush. Professional certainty without hardness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。博覧会の準備会議を開きます
lines.en: Got it. I'll set up the expo prep meeting.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Warm and efficient. Small finality — he's wrapping up the list. Reliable competence. Soft close on "meeting."
